evidence: The existing organization scenario engine remains the mutation source of truth.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Cycle validation and impact preview remain behaviorally identical to the existing organization engine.
evidence: OrganizationScenarioService continues to call the existing graph validators and OrganizationChartService projections.
OrganizationScenarioServiceTest and OrganizationPublishRolloutGateTest passed in the bounded cluster.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Wrong tenant, legal entity, organization scope, purpose, field decision or policy revision fails closed without node-existence disclosure.
evidence: The bounded HcmV3PepRegistryTest, HcmProductSurfacePepFilterTest and HcmOwnerPepExecutionTest passed 41 tests.
Only the two exact graph route keys require ORGANIZATION and revalidate ORGANIZATION_TARGET_POPULATION; management and legacy operations branches retain their prior resolver behavior.
Frontend adapter instances use a serializable per-instance cache discriminator, and cached 403/404 results conceal the previous graph before rendering permission/not-found state.

acceptanceResults.criterion: A successful enabled publication appends exactly one OrganizationChanged.v1 envelope with XCON-006 payload and source revision.
evidence: OrganizationScenarioService appends through OrganizationChangedOutbox only after the existing publish boundary succeeds.
OrganizationChangedOutboxTest passed 4 tests; OrganizationScenarioServiceTest verifies event count, source revision, changed organizations and no event before success.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Exact replay is idempotent, mismatched replay conflicts, and failed publication emits no event.
evidence: Event and revision UUIDs are deterministic and replay comparison includes tenant, aggregate, event type, payload, correlation and occurrence time.
OrganizationChangedOutboxTest and OrganizationScenarioServiceTest cover exact replay, mismatch and failed-publication no-append behavior.
Rollback on an outbox insert failure is established by the service transaction plus outbox Propagation.MANDATORY; no separate real-database rollback integration test is claimed.

acceptanceResults.criterion: The canonical route adapts OrganizationExplorer and preserves tab, as-of date, selected focus and return navigation.
evidence: OrganizationExplorer accepts only the sealed HrisOrganizationPositionsQueryAdapter kind/query seam; its management branch remains unchanged.
organization-positions-workspace.test.tsx covers tab=overview, asOf, focus selection, keyboard focus and Return to graph URL behavior.
Upper-case input UUIDs normalize to canonical lower case before query and response comparison.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Loading, empty, unavailable, partial, complete, permission-denied and stale states are materially distinct and never blank.
evidence: organization-positions-workspace.test.tsx covers all seven states plus required-root first-use and invalid-filter states.
Permission and non-disclosed-root failures conceal cached graph data; other refresh failures may retain the last authorized snapshot under an explicit stale warning.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Deep links and actions are allowlisted and hidden or disabled from the same server-authoritative access decision.
evidence: Unknown or ambiguous focus selectors do not open an inspector or issue a second owner query.
The runtime gate and sealed adapter determine mounting; the adapter carries the server-authoritative request scope and adapter replacement starts an isolated pending query without prior-data reuse.
This module adds no management mutation hooks.

acceptanceResults.criterion: 1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom plus light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion and keyboard navigation pass.
evidence: Component source includes responsive breakpoints, forced-colors borders, semantic lists/aside, aria labels, focusable buttons and no motion dependency.
Targeted Vitest covers keyboard-focusable inspection and nonblank responsive component states.
